note: Source-of-truth map for every critical entity. SOURCE = where the value is edited; GENERATOR = what transforms it; OUTPUT = what ships; RUNTIME = what the browser applies over the output; DEPLOYMENT = how it reaches ekguru.shop. Where two stores exist, precedence is explicit and enforced by tests (see 'gates').

tutors.source: owner Google Sheet (gids in js/site-config.js: tutors 1631273256) + hand-written js/tutors/<id>.js for fields the owner does not own (bio, about, experience, methodology, photo)
tutors.generator: tools/sheetsync.js  (live sheet -> js/tutors/_overrides.js, written at build time; buildTutor refuses rating/reviewsCount/lessonsCount/superTutor/preplyUrl cells — 27 Sep 2026 policy, unit-tested by tools/test-sheetsync-policy.js)
tutors.output: js/tutors/_overrides.js (snapshot of the sheet as of last build) + pre-rendered pages (tutor/<id>/index.html, home cards, feed.xml) via tools/build-tutor-pages.js + tools/build-home-tutors.js
tutors.runtime: js/sheet.js fetches the published CSV and applies the sheet over the merged roster in the visitor's browser — the SAME five cells return null in FIELDS, so a stale sheet can no longer re-publish marketplace metrics or profile links (regression-tested by tools/test-sheet-apply.js third pass). Roster merge: js/tutors-data.js (files first, overrides on top, hidden ids excluded).
tutors.precedence: runtime sheet > _overrides.js > tutor file. Pre-rendered HTML is the crawlable fallback and is regenerated from the same merged data (tools/lib/site-data.js — the ONE loader for build and check, so generated and browser data cannot diverge).
gates: tools/test-sheet-apply.js (runtime, 34 checks incl. adversarial stale row)

reviews.generator: tools/sheetsync.js buildReviews() — rows sourced from preply/italki are skipped with a logged reason; only site-native reviews are baked
reviews.output: reviews arrays inside js/tutors/_overrides.js (rating/reviewsCount derived from the site-native count; 0 when none)
reviews.runtime: js/reviews.js applies review rows with the same marketplace-source gate; the profile UI renders 'Left through EkGuru' for on-site reviews only; no AggregateRating schema exists anywhere (no rating without real evidence)
gates: tools/test-no-competitor-attribution.js (no 'marketplace review' / attribution wording in public output)

courses.source: course data files under data/ (per-language lesson/vocab/dialogue/question/test files) indexed by data/courses/index.json
courses.output: languages/<code>/…, learn/<slug>/…, /courses/ hub, A1–C2 level pages
courses.precedence: single chain: data files -> generators -> pages; on-page counts are generated from the same files, so claim-vs-content is equal by construction (verified by tools/test-course-levels.mjs + the Phase-10 recount)

languages.output: language hub + per-language pages + country-language pages + language-course-matrix join (data/quality/language-course-matrix.json)
languages.precedence: registries are the only authority; publishing state (PRODUCTION/AVAILABLE/BETA split) comes from the phase7c registries; incomplete languages are quarantined by tools/quarantine-language-surfaces.py (noindex, out of sitemap, no ads)

pricing.source: owner Sheet priceUSD cell (tutor's stated price) — the ONLY price the site publishes
pricing.output: cards + profiles as 'profile-listed price; confirm current terms'
pricing.runtime: js/sheet.js applies priceUSD; js/rates.js + js/pricing.js convert for display only (USD × published FX rate, rounded to nearest ₹50 — display normalisation, never a price change; sources open.er-api.com with cdn.jsdelivr.net fallback)
pricing.precedence: sheet wins over file for priceUSD

availability.source: owner Sheet availability cell (day + time slots) — the tutor's stated schedule, not a live booking system
availability.runtime: js/sheet.js applies; UI shows timezone conversion and 'not live, confirm' wording

verification.source: owner Sheet verified cell (owner's own decision)
verification.runtime: applied as data (verified: true); NOT rendered as a public badge anywhere, so it can never read as a claim
verification.precedence: sheet wins; superTutor is refused (badge is earned by an on-site record, which does not exist)

sitemap_membership.generator: tools/build-sitemaps.py (publication gate: noindex/placeholder/research/draft never enter a sitemap) + per-section sitemap writers (sitemap-tutors.xml in build-tutor-pages.js, courses, questions…)
sitemap_membership.precedence: robots meta on the page is the authority; the sitemap gate enforces IN_SITEMAP => INDEXABLE and INDEXABLE => IN_SITEMAP (verified 0 violations by data/quality/full-page-inventory.json)

page_state.source: robots meta in each page + data-ad-class attribute
page_state.generator: python3 tools/inject-ads.py (tags every page with its class), quarantine-* tools (research/draft language/tutor surfaces)
page_state.runtime: js/monetization/monetization.js reads class + consent + ADS_RUNTIME_ENABLED (triple gate)
page_state.precedence: class is data; the runtime flag is the switch; both enforced independently

ad_eligibility.runtime: js/monetization/monetization.js: isAdEligible = class allowed AND consent granted AND ADS_RUNTIME_ENABLED (currently false site-wide)
ad_eligibility.output: reports/public-page-ad-readiness.json (810 eligible by class / 1,827 excluded / 0 runtime-enabled)

consent_state.source: visitor choice stored in localStorage (the local banner is honest: it is NOT a Google-certified CMP)
consent_state.runtime: js/cookie-consent.js state machine; ADVERTISING_AVAILABLE=false fail-closed; analytics (GoatCounter, cookieless) load post-consent only
consent_state.owner_action: Google-certified TCF CMP for EEA/UK/CH must be configured in the AdSense console (account-side)

affiliate_state.runtime: js/affiliate/affiliate.js neutralises a[data-affiliate] anchors; no disclosure/label/tracking can appear without an approved+enabled program and an allowed placement

seo_metadata.source: page files (title/meta/h1/canonical/hreflang written by generators or by hand)
seo_metadata.generator: tools/build-tutor-pages.js (profile LD+JSON), tools/build-shell.js (header/footer on all 2,635 pages), per-page canonicals
seo_metadata.output: every indexable page: exactly one canonical = its own https://ekguru.shop URL, one H1, unique title/meta (0 duplicate groups), hreflang 7 locales + x-default
seo_metadata.runtime: js/seo.js maintains runtime schema (Person + VideoObject; no sameAs to marketplaces after 27 Sep)

payment_state.source: Razorpay (hosted payment link RAZORPAY_PAYMENT_LINK in js/site-config.js) + server/ (Apps Script order create/verify/webhook)
payment_state.runtime: server verifies HMAC BEFORE parsing the payment body; idempotent reconciliation; the site UI is in honest COMING_SOON state for online support; mock checkout hard-blocked on production
gates: node tools/test-browser-qa.mjs (no Razorpay script on public pages)

mail_state.source: Apps Script mail endpoints (js/site-config.js) — booking/contact flows
mail_state.runtime: js/main.js builds mailto + Apps Script submissions; recipients/From/subject escaping audited; no secrets in frontend

anti_stale_fallback_contract.rule: No stale CSV fallback and no generated-JS fallback may recreate removed values.
enforcement: js/sheet.js FIELDS: rating/reviewsCount/lessonsCount/superTutor/preplyUrl => null on the update, create AND record-only paths
js/reviews.js: marketplace-source rows skipped before they can enter a rating
tools/sheetsync.js buildTutor/buildReviews: identical policy at build time (mirrored, unit-tested)
js/livepatch.js reads values only through the js/sheet.js records — there is no second apply path
tools/test-sheet-apply.js third pass + tools/test-sheetsync-policy.js prove the adversarial row (5/3/40/superTutor/marketplace URL) leaks nothing, on both sides, in every run
